audit: post-merge fidelity of ugence-agent-runtime vs legacy agent_runtime_migration

subsystems.note: Different control flow and API; not a relocation.
Planning is not a coordination-kernel concern.
Neutral models replace agent contracts; not the same types.
Reimplemented with different status vocabulary and checkpoint format.
cancellation/retry present but reworked; budget/resolution excluded.
Provider boundary replaces tool registry; selection/policy excluded.
Event vocabulary changed to coordination events.
Concrete CER construction; stays legacy, not in neutral kernel.
Concrete cer_v0_3 control-plane integration; replaced in kernel by a neutral hook. Legacy retained as integration assembly.
Validation harnesses; parity imports agentic and is not part of the kernel.

governance_gaps_corrected.gap: fail-open default (NoopGovernanceHook returns CLEAR by default)
governance_gaps_corrected.resolution: UnconfiguredGovernanceHook (BLOCK) is the default; AllowAllGovernanceHook is explicit opt-in and documented unsafe.

governance_gaps_corrected.gap: no immutable proposal fingerprint / exact-action binding
governance_gaps_corrected.resolution: TransitionProposal + deterministic fingerprint constructed before evaluation and bound to the exact invocation; runtime fails closed on missing/unknown/mismatch/expiry/missing-reference.

governance_gaps_corrected.gap: CLEAR did not require a non-empty binding reference
governance_gaps_corrected.resolution: CLEAR without a binding reference (evaluation/authorization/clearance) fails closed.
expired CLEAR fails closed at the execution check using the injected clock.

compatibility_correction.note: Legacy AgentRuntime API is incompatible with the kernel API; false identity claims removed; migration map + fidelity matrix published; a real test imports the legacy path to prove coexistence (skipped when the monorepo is absent).
